terms_modal.title: Terms of Service
terms_modal.sec1_desc: Welcome to Domin Tactic (ApartAWS). By registering an account and using our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms of use.
terms_modal.sec2_desc: When creating an account, you must provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information. You are responsible for safeguarding your password and for any activities under your account.
terms_modal.sec3_desc_1: All booking requests must comply with the verification and confirmation process of our system or the apartment owner.
terms_modal.sec3_desc_2: Prices displayed on the system are final and include all applicable taxes and fees.
terms_modal.sec3_desc_3: Cancellations and refunds will apply according to the cancellation policy of each apartment specified at the booking time.
terms_modal.sec4_desc_1: Using the service for any illegal purpose.
terms_modal.sec4_desc_2: Providing false information or posting misleading content that violates public morality.
terms_modal.sec4_desc_3: Interfering with or disrupting the technical system of Domin Tactic.
terms_modal.sec5_desc: Domin Tactic is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use or inability to use our services.

privacy_modal.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_modal.sec1_desc: When registering an account at Domin Tactic (ApartAWS), we collect certain personal information including your full name, email address, phone number, and other transaction details required to provide services.
privacy_modal.sec2_desc_intro: Your personal information is collected for the following purposes:
privacy_modal.sec2_desc_1: Verifying your account and processing booking requests.
privacy_modal.sec2_desc_2: Sending notifications related to transaction status and customer support.
privacy_modal.sec2_desc_3: Improving service quality and enhancing user experience.
privacy_modal.sec2_desc_4: Sending promotional information or important updates (if you opt-in).
privacy_modal.sec3_desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. Your account password is encrypted securely on our system.
privacy_modal.sec4_desc_intro: We commit not to sell or trade your personal information with third parties. However, information may be shared in these cases:
privacy_modal.sec4_desc_1: Sharing necessary contact information with the property owners to complete booking.
privacy_modal.sec4_desc_2: When legally requested by competent government authorities.
privacy_modal.sec5_desc: You have the right to access, edit, or request the deletion of your personal information at any time through your account settings or by contacting our support team.
